tools.name: get_company_profile
tools.description: Who Corazor Technology is: global AI product engineering and technical partner (HQ Gurugram, India; clients in US, UK, Europe, Middle East, APAC, India), working style, roles, contact details, and how to engage.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: Full service catalog (AI development, SaaS, web, mobile, audits, SOC 2 / ISO 27001 readiness, continuous assurance) plus engagement models and regions served. Optionally filter by category.

tools.name: get_case_studies
tools.description: Shipped client projects with challenge, solution, outcomes, and links. Optionally filter by keyword (industry or technology).

tools.name: check_fit
tools.description: Given a short project brief, return the best-matching Corazor services, a recommended engagement model, and the next step.

tools.name: get_booking_link
tools.description: Link where the user can book a free 30-minute intro call with Corazor.

tools.name: submit_inquiry
tools.description: Send a project inquiry to Corazor on the user's behalf. Only call with the user's explicit consent and their real name and email. Corazor replies within one business day.
